content: Aarav Sharma called to inquire about his auto insurance policy, suspecting it had expired. Agent Suresh Deshmukh confirmed the policy expired on March 10th. Aarav expressed surprise at not receiving a notification. Suresh offered to renew the policy immediately over the phone and committed to updating Aarav's contact information to ensure future notifications are received.

action_items: Renew auto insurance policy over the phone
Update customer contact information to ensure future notice delivery
